title: Hina Change
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shy, bullied high schooler Hina and her childhood friend Ren have shared a secret since childhood: they can swap bodies. Ren, a closeted gay student, is rejected by his friend Makoto, and when the two swap, Ren uses Hina's body to begin a sexual relationship with Makoto. The short series follows the fallout of the repeated swaps for all three teens.
life_message: Living through someone else's body or a fantasy cannot replace accepting who you are.

content.note: Bullying scenes by classmates; no combat (AniList Bullying).

folkways.japan: A closeted student's reluctance to come out and the girl's quiet endurance of classroom bullying reflect Japanese school pressures toward conformity.

delivery.evidence: MAL reviewer says the climax shows characters accepting who they are; compares it to toxic-relationship dramas; no preachiness noted.
delivery.note: The one review read describes a drama that lets its characters' damaging choices and growth carry the point rather than speeches.

winners_losers: Summaries suggest the teens move toward self-acceptance after painful choices; sympathy goes to Hina and Ren as wounded people rather than to the deception itself.
